name: vicoa-desktop
description: Electron shell for the Vicoa desktop app
//vicoaDaemonVersion: Pinned vicoa-ai/vicoa release whose daemon is bundled (scripts/stage-daemon.mjs). Bump this ONE line to ship a newer daemon. Overridable per build via VICOA_DAEMON_VERSION / VICOA_DAEMON_DIST.

scripts.stage:all: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run stage:daemon && pnpm run build:notification-status && pnpm run make:icon && tsc
scripts.//stage:all:win: Windows staging. Skips make:icon (needs the macOS sips/iconutil/swift toolchain; resources/icon.ico is committed) and build:notification-status (macOS-only helper, self-skips anyway).
scripts.stage:all:win: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run stage:daemon && tsc
scripts.//stage:all:linux: Linux staging. Like Windows, skips make:icon (macOS-only toolchain; resources/icon-linux.png is committed) and build:notification-status (macOS-only helper).
scripts.stage:all:linux: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run stage:daemon && tsc
scripts.package:release: pnpm run stage:all && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
scripts.//package:win: Windows build. UNSIGNED by design — no env gate, so a local build and the CI release differ only in --publish.
scripts.package:win: pnpm run stage:all:win && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.package:win:release: pnpm run stage:all:win && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
scripts.//package:linux: Linux build (AppImage, x64). UNSIGNED by design; a local build and the CI release differ only in --publish. Must run ON Linux — the frozen daemon is native and stage-daemon stages for the host platform.
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run stage:all:linux && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.package:linux:release: pnpm run stage:all:linux && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
scripts.//package:release:local: Fast local pre-flight: real Developer ID signing (cert must be in your keychain) but skips Apple notarization + publish, host arch only — catch signing/packaging bugs in ~2-3 min before pushing a desktop-v* tag.
scripts.package:release:local: VICOA_MAC_RELEASE=1 VICOA_SKIP_NOTARIZE=1 pnpm run stage:all && VICOA_MAC_RELEASE=1 VICOA_SKIP_NOTARIZE=1 electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
